venues.name: Central Park
venues.why: Endless flat, paved paths and playgrounds — the easiest stroller-nap loop in the city, and free.

hl.stroller: Miles of smooth, level paths — even a double stroller rolls easily.
hl.naptimed: Find a quiet bench by the Mall and the stroller does the rest.
hl.free: No ticket needed — wander as long as the kids are happy.

venues.name: American Museum of Natural History
venues.why: Dinosaurs, the blue whale, and the planetarium — fully indoor with elevators and changing tables.

hl.stroller: Elevators reach every floor; visitors confirm it's fully stroller-friendly.
hl.indoor: A huge indoor day — the go-to when the weather turns.

venues.name: Bronx Zoo
venues.why: One of the country's largest zoos with wide, stroller-easy paths and a dedicated children's zoo.

hl.stroller: Broad paved loops — families say it's an easy push between exhibits.

venues.name: Brooklyn Bridge Park
venues.why: Flat riverside paths with skyline views and playgrounds — a calm, free stroller stretch.

hl.stroller: Smooth waterfront promenade from end to end.
hl.naptimed: The breezy river walk is a reliable nap-window stroll.
hl.free: Free and open — an easy add-on near DUMBO.

venues.name: The High Line
venues.why: A flat, car-free elevated garden walk — stroller-smooth, scenic, and free.

hl.stroller: Step-free the whole way (use the elevators at access points).
hl.naptimed: A gentle, steady stroll above the streets — good for a nap.
hl.free: No ticket — a quick, pretty stretch between Chelsea stops.

venues.name: Intrepid Museum
venues.why: A real aircraft carrier, a space shuttle, and a submarine — big, indoor, and a hit with kids.

hl.stroller: Elevators and ramps connect the decks for strollers.
hl.indoor: Mostly indoor — a solid all-weather plan on the West Side.

venues.name: Children's Museum of Manhattan
venues.why: Five floors built for little kids — hands-on play, story time, and a toddler zone.

hl.stroller: Stroller parking inside and step-free play areas.
hl.indoor: All-indoor and designed for under-10s — a great backup.

venues.name: Battery Park
venues.why: Open harbor-front lawns with Statue of Liberty views — a calm, free finish to the day.

hl.stroller: Wide, flat paths along the water.
hl.naptimed: Sea breeze and open space — an easy wind-down.
hl.free: Free views of the harbor and Lady Liberty.

venues.name: Junior's Restaurant
venues.why: A classic diner with a real kids' menu, high chairs, and famous cheesecake to seal the deal.

hl.kidmenu: Kids' menu and high chairs ready — easy with picky eaters.
hl.indoor: Roomy indoor booths for a calm midday reset.

venues.name: Joe's Pizza
venues.why: Fast, cheap, beloved plain slices kids actually eat — grab a slice and keep moving.

hl.kidmenu: Simple cheese slices please little eaters.
hl.indoor: A quick indoor refuel between stops.

venues.name: Shake Shack — Madison Square
venues.why: The original Shake Shack by the park — burgers, a kids' menu, and high chairs.

hl.kidmenu: Kid-sized burgers and shakes; high chairs on hand.
hl.indoor: Order and sit by Madison Square Park.

hotels.name: Hotel Beacon
hotels.why: Kitchenette suites on the calm Upper West Side — walk to the Natural History museum and Central Park. A longtime family favorite.

hotels.name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Manhattan Times Square
hotels.why: Apartment-style two-room suites and a made-to-order breakfast give everyone space to recharge, a short walk from Times Square and the subway.
hotels.note: Heads up: Midtown can be loud — ask for a higher floor.

hotels.name: Hyatt Place New York/Midtown-South
hotels.why: Roomy rooms with a pull-out sofa, free breakfast, and an easy walk to the Empire State Building.

hotels.name: The Manhattan at Times Square
hotels.why: A budget-friendly, very central base with connecting rooms for bigger families.
